Vasylivka Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Zaporizhia Oblast, Ukraine

Demolished. Vasylivka's Jewish community maintained a cheder by 1846 and a synagogue by 1885, reaching 252 people (30 percent of the town) by 1897, though this had fallen to just 97 by 1939. Forty-two Jews were shot here in October 1941. According to local residents, this cemetery's tombstones were gradually taken over the years for private house construction until none remained on site; locals and museum staff also report that archaeologists periodically dug at the site. Fragments recovered by residents, including a well-preserved tree-shaped tombstone, are now held at the local museum.
